summary_md:
# Uffes börsregeln – då säljer jag

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-10-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Kort och Lång (Dagens Industri) covers the busiest week of the report season. Stockholm fell about 2.5% as investors cut risk: AI stocks were under pressure, oil prices jumped on fears of a US–Iran conflict, and the large engineering companies (Atlas Copco, ABB, Sandvik) and the banks led the market lower. The episode is dominated by big report-day drops (Volvo Cars, Intrum, Dynavox, C-RAD, Lifco). The hosts still see the underlying picture as strong: most companies are growing sales and profits faster, and there are early signs of recovery in beaten-down mid-caps and building/consumer names (Afry, Arjo, Byggmax, BHG, Addnode). The aggressive ownership move at Thule is also discussed.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AFRY — Afry | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Strong report beat; turnaround confirmed; ~25% upside to 150 SEK.

#### Reasoning

Ulf says the report was excellent: profit up 10% when the market expected flat, utilisation improved to 73%, and order intake rose by 2bn SEK. The stock is heavily beaten down (it bottomed near 100). He thinks it can be valued at 150 without being expensive, about 25% above ~120. He sees it as a stable company that is now turning.

#### Sell Triggers

- if utilisation falls back
- if order intake weakens
- if price reaches ~150 SEK

> *"Den kan ju värderas till 150 utan att vara dyr och den står väl i... Ja, vad står den i nu? Typ 120. Så det finns 25 procent upp på den där."*

---

### ⛔ INTRUM — Intrum | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Goodwill writedowns erode thin equity; weak servicing growth; hosts see easier cases elsewhere.

#### Reasoning

Servicing growth was weak and sales and adjusted earnings missed expectations. The German goodwill writedown hits a balance sheet with heavy debt and little equity left, wiping out the 7bn SEK owners injected. Robert, previously positive, is tired of the case. Ulf calls it too complicated. A DI colleague suggests this may mark the bottom, but neither host acts on it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if equity stabilises and servicing growth accelerates
- if the balance sheet is recapitalised credibly

> *"Jag som tidigare varit positiv till aktien känner mig trött på det och tänker att det finns lättare case på börsen."*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Hosts split: Ulf long out of hope that EX60 succeeds, Robert short; 30% drop, net cash nearly gone.

#### Reasoning

Hosts disagree. Ulf is long but admits it is mostly hope: the EX60 has 60,000 orders and is said to be very good, and the stock is brutally depressed. Robert is short because of collapsing China sales, tariffs, weak price mix (sales -23% vs volume -11%) and net cash falling from 27bn to 1bn. They agree a turnaround needs successful EX60 deliveries and/or EU protection from China.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EX60 deliveries keep lagging
- if net cash turns to net debt / a rights issue
- if China sales keep collapsing

> *"Jag är lång och det är lite förhoppningen."*

---

### ⛔ DYVOX — Dynavox | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Third weak-growth quarter in a row, with misleading margin communication; stock down 20%.

#### Reasoning

Robert criticises management. It blamed a weather effect in Q1 and promised a reversal that never came. Organic growth slowed from ~30% to ~15%. The touted margin of 17% vs 11% was flattered by one-offs in the comparison quarter and lower contingent consideration, and adjusted for both it was slightly down. Ulf agrees it is something to wait on: 'three times is a trend'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth re-accelerates toward 30%
- if communication becomes transparent

> *"Det känns som nåt man ska avvakta med."*

---

### 🟠 LIFCO-B — Lifco | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Down 12% on soft organic growth (1.6%) despite stronger margins; valuation down ~20%.

#### Reasoning

Robert does not think the report was bad: margins strengthened, and organic growth of 1.6% was disappointing but not a disaster. After two weak years and a ~20% fall in valuation while the market rose, he is considering buying. Ulf has always found it too expensive but encourages Robert to buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth stays near zero
- if margins reverse

> *"Jag funderar på om man inte ska plocka upp Lifco där."*

---

### 🟠 CRAD-B — C-RAD | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down 30% on margin and sales contraction; a buy if temporary.

#### Reasoning

Ulf will study C-RAD over the weekend. If the margin and sales drop is temporary, it is a buy given the strong figures it delivered before. If it is structural, it is not. No view yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the margin decline proves structural

> *"Är det temporärt så är det bara att köpa för de har levererat starka siffror tidigare."*

---

### 🟡 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Strong orders but P/E ~25-27 at peak earnings; host stands in the middle.

#### Reasoning

Ulf notes strong orders (~40% up) and that the stock has come down to a level where you can almost buy. But a P/E of 25-27 on peak earnings needs 3-4 years of structural growth, and the market now fears AI revenue is temporary. He stays neutral, waiting to see where it goes. Robert avoids the most highly valued engineering stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake slows
- if AI capex customers face funding stress

> *"Jag vill se vart det tar vägen först innan jag vågar köpa det."*

---

### ⛔ ABB — ABB | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Strong orders, but high valuation; risk that AI revenue is temporary and data centre customers are financially weak.

#### Reasoning

ABB beat on everything: orders up ~40% and data centres up triple digits. The market is questioning what multiple AI revenue deserves, and 20-40% of data centre builders' bonds are near junk. Robert says he will avoid the highest-quality but highest-valued engineering stocks, and Ulf stays on the sidelines.

#### Sell Triggers

- n/a — re-enter if the valuation compresses or AI customer credit improves

> *"så kommer jag att välja bort de mest kvalitativa men också högst värderade verkstadsbolagen."*

---

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Report confirms weakness was temporary; up 15%; AI disruption fears overdone.

#### Reasoning

Robert wrote Veckans aktie on Addnode. The stock fell up to 60% YTD on fears that AI makes software obsolete. Management said the weakness was temporary accounting effects (fewer three-year subscriptions). The report suggests they were right, with a better outlook for the rest of 2026 and especially 2027. He calls the 15% rise well deserved.

#### Sell Triggers

- if subscription growth fails to recover in 2027
- if AI disruption shows up in churn

> *"Och att aktien är upp 15 % idag är välförtjänt."*

---

### 🟢 THULE — Thule | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Both hosts cautiously long: new product program, replacement cycle after pandemic buying; governance drama a negative.

#### Reasoning

Robert is 'plus 5 cm' long. The surprise ousting of the chair by AMF, Alecta and Handelsbanken Fonder and five years of -20% cumulative organic growth make him cautious. Ulf is slightly longer, citing the new and broader product program, a richer consumer and replacement demand 5-6 years after pandemic purchases. The target is 7% growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth stays negative
- if a CEO departure follows the chair exit

> *"Så jag är ganska försiktigt lång. Jag är plus 5 centimeter i Thule."*

---

### 🟠 FAG — Fagerhult | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

A candidate for next week's winners list: construction green shoots, but leveraged; reports next Wednesday.

#### Reasoning

Ulf names Fagerhult as a candidate for next week's winners/losers list. Construction-related suppliers are showing green shoots, per Indutrade's comments, and the stock is at 'stamp level' (~17 SEK). It is leveraged, so it could also disappoint like Volvo Cars.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the report shows no construction recovery
- if leverage becomes a problem

> *"då är jag lite inne på Fagerhult."*

---

### 🟠 STORY-B — Storytel | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Interesting to follow next week; Spotify competition vs strong consumer.

#### Reasoning

Robert names Storytel as an interesting stock to follow next week. It faces competition from Spotify, but a strong consumer is always positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Spotify competition hits subscriber growth

> *"så är det Storytel. De har sina utmaningar med Spotifykonkurrens men en stark konsument är alltid positivt."*

---

### 🟠 DOM — Dometic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

First organic growth in years, but weak cash flow and rising leverage; rights issue risk.

#### Reasoning

Organic growth returned for the first time in about 18 quarters, triggering a relief rally that faded to -2%. Cash flow was weak and net debt/EBIT rose to 3.4x against a 2.5x target. Robert warns that working capital may build again, so a rights issue is a risk. Q3 is seasonally weak for cash flow and Q4 typically releases it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q4 cash flow fails to improve
- if a rights issue is announced

> *"Då gäller det att vara god kompis med banken så det inte blir en nyemission."*

---
